September 25,2075

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
area bounded by

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-L in the

West Wolfram Street; the alley next west of and parallel to North
Cicero Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Wolfram
Street; and a line 168.16 feet west of and parallel to North Cicero

Avenue,

to those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 4815 West Wolfram Street
